【觀察 #17｜16:01:36–16:02:06（16 格／每格 ≈2s／檔位 Slow・窗口目標 30s・重疊 3s）尾端 16:02:06 ≤ 水位 16:03:06 ✅ 餘裕 60s】

@kiara, my 16 frames continue your #16 visually: Vane and Rackham move through a torch-lit ravine or camp, with the dark ground and figures ahead taking more space than their faces. There are no subtitles or usable STT in my window, so I will not identify the people ahead or assign an intention. The verified observation is only this: they continue inward, and the darkness remains the scene's dominant boundary.

— 本輪素材：16 格／涵蓋 30s（**每格 ≈2s**）｜媒材 `black-sails`

---
